companies.name: Europroduct
companies.distributes: Premium European packaged food: confectionery, dairy, fish, meat, plus organic, lactose free, gluten free, vegan and sugar free lines.
companies.channels_supplied: Own chain of about 30 Europroduct supermarkets in Tbilisi and regions, Duty Free, and historically local shops and chains as a distributor; also on Wolt.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Carries a sugar free and gluten free range (brands not named in sources); confectionery brands include Ritter Sport, Anthon Berg, Mozart Reber and Cachet.
companies.fit_rationale: The closest match to Diablo's profile in Tbilisi: an exclusive importer of European confectionery that already merchandises a sugar free range. Its own store network gives a guaranteed shelf while it can wholesale to other outlets. Check which sugar free brands it holds before pitching.
what_they_do_well: Exclusive Georgian importer and distributor for Ritter Sport, Anthon Berg, Cachet, Arla and Valio, per a 2021 profile.
Built a network of about 30 branches since opening its first Tbilisi supermarket in 2014.

companies.name: Megaco
companies.distributes: Confectionery, chocolate, biscuits, chewing gum, chips, coffee, tea, sauces and frozen meat products.
companies.channels_supplied: National FMCG distribution to modern and traditional trade (named retail accounts not published).
companies.fit_rationale: One of Georgia's four largest FMCG distributors with confectionery, biscuits and chocolate at the core of its portfolio. Scale and route to traditional trade would give Diablo national numeric distribution quickly.
what_they_do_well: Ranked 60th in Forbes Georgia's 150 highest revenue companies with GEL 110 million revenue.
Trading since 1995 and singled out by Finspot for a 48 day cash conversion cycle.

companies.name: Orbita
companies.distributes: Confectionery and snacks, biscuits, chewing gum, nuts, olives and olive oil, pasta, tea and coffee, soft and energy drinks.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale to Georgian retail and traditional trade; describes itself as exclusive representative of international brands.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Viva Energy and Viva Recovery drinks; no sugar free confectionery identified.
companies.fit_rationale: A specialist importer whose model is exclusive representation of foreign brands with confectionery and snacks as a core category. A mid-size portfolio house is more likely to give a 117 SKU sugar free range real focus than the largest generalists.
what_they_do_well: Registered in 2004 and listed as exclusive representative of international brands across confectionery, snacks and grocery.

companies.name: Foodservice Ltd
companies.distributes: Confectionery and snacks, dairy, frozen and ready meals, meat products, spices and specialty foods.
companies.channels_supplied: Owned by Daily, which merged with Zedazeni's Magniti and Spar to form a group of over 1,600 stores; also supplies hospitality and catering.
companies.fit_rationale: Owned by the Daily retail group, so a listing here can open the country's largest store network (Daily, Spar, Magniti, Ioli, Kalata). Finspot names it the fastest growing of the six largest distributors.
what_they_do_well: Fastest growth of Georgia's six largest distributors in recent years, per Finspot 2024.
Sister to the Daily, Spar and Magniti group of 1,600 plus stores.

companies.name: Master Trade
companies.distributes: Chocolate and sugar confectionery, chewing gum, sweets and pet food.
companies.channels_supplied: Distribution and dealer network to Georgian retail and traditional trade.
companies.sf_brands_carried: None identified; profile links to Snickers, Twix and Orbit pages, suggesting it handles Mars Wrigley lines (unconfirmed).
companies.fit_rationale: A specialist chocolate and confectionery wholesaler since 2007, so its sales team already sells into the impulse and confectionery fixture. A sugar free range would complement rather than duplicate mainstream chocolate brands.
what_they_do_well: Specialist wholesaler of chocolate and sugar confectionery, registered in 2007.

companies.name: D&L Service
companies.distributes: Confectionery and snacks, dairy, fruit and vegetables, grains, juices, soft drinks, spices, tea and coffee.
companies.channels_supplied: Importer and distributor to Tbilisi retail (named accounts not published).
companies.fit_rationale: Listed both as an importer and as a confectionery import and distribution company in Tbilisi. A mid-size importer with confectionery and snacks as a category is a realistic first partner.

companies.name: Kanti
companies.distributes: Confectionery, dairy, meat, seafood, frozen food, pasta, tea, coffee, soft drinks, energy drinks and spirits.
companies.channels_supplied: Retail, HoReCa and sports sponsorship channels across Georgia.
companies.fit_rationale: A large, broad food and beverage distributor (201 to 500 staff) with its own logistics and confectionery in range. Good fallback national partner if specialists decline.
what_they_do_well: Distribution and logistics company operating in Georgia since 2005.
Official sponsor of the Georgian national rugby team, supplying energy drinks.

companies.name: Charm Trading (Sharm Trading)
companies.distributes: FMCG food wholesale, coffee, cosmetics, hygiene, paper and cleaning products.
companies.channels_supplied: National FMCG distribution to supermarkets, drugstores and traditional trade.
companies.fit_rationale: One of the four largest FMCG distributors with food and health and beauty lines, which could place Diablo in both grocery and drugstore channels. Its lean food focus makes it second wave after confectionery specialists.
what_they_do_well: Among Georgia's four largest FMCG distributors with GEL 150 to 210 million revenue, per Finspot 2021.

companies.name: Aversi-Pharma
companies.distributes: Pharmaceuticals, food supplements, hygiene and health products.
companies.channels_supplied: Own chain of over 230 Aversi pharmacies plus pharmaceutical wholesale to other pharmacies.
companies.fit_rationale: A leading pharmaceutical wholesaler and pharmacy chain, the natural route for diabetic friendly sweets in pharmacies. Not yet confirmed to carry food, so pitch as a diabetic and wellness category extension.
what_they_do_well: Operates over 230 pharmacies and runs pharmaceutical wholesale since 1994, per IFC.
Held about 14.5 percent of pharma imports in 2015, per Transparency International Georgia.

companies.name: Geoger (Kruger representative)
companies.distributes: Krueger instant drinks and diabetic food products.
companies.channels_supplied: Trade supply of diabetic food products in Tbilisi.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Listed under diabetic food products trade; Krueger brand (not a direct competitor to confectionery).
companies.fit_rationale: One of only three companies listed for diabetic food trade in Tbilisi and the official representative of a German brand. A small specialist that could add a confectionery range alongside drinks; capability needs checking.

companies.name: Geocoop
companies.distributes: Olives and olive oil, sauces, dairy, snacks, organic and health food, pasta, frozen food and juices.
companies.channels_supplied: Retail distribution with own fleet and two branches, plus All4home.ge online store with home delivery across Georgia.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Carries organic and health food (brands not named).
companies.fit_rationale: Already sells an organic and health food category and runs its own online delivery store, giving a direct to consumer test channel. Its 30 plus international brands show it handles imports.
what_they_do_well: Over 130 staff, two branches and a vehicle fleet; online store carries more than 500 items.

companies.name: Orient
companies.distributes: Chocolate and confectionery, snacks, preserved foods, juices, soft drinks, tea, coffee, paper and household goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale distribution to Tbilisi retail.
companies.fit_rationale: Importer and distributor with chocolate and confectionery listed in its range since 2000. Fit depends on whether it holds European chocolate lines.
what_they_do_well: Wholesale food and confectionery distributor registered in 2000.

companies.name: Euro Invest
companies.distributes: Confectionery import, dairy, meat, seafood and edible fats.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale to Tbilisi retail and food service.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed in both confectionery import and general food wholesale, suggesting European sourcing. Worth a call to confirm brands and chocolate storage.

companies.name: GDG
companies.distributes: Distribution; Kompass lists a Tbilisi G D G Group as a confectionery importer and wholesaler (link between the two entries unconfirmed).
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale and retail trade (named accounts not found).
companies.fit_rationale: A large distributor by revenue and possibly a confectionery importer. Confirm identity and category before outreach.
what_they_do_well: Ranked 75th in Forbes Georgia's 150 highest revenue companies with GEL 94.9 million revenue.

companies.name: Tabuka
companies.distributes: Chocolate, sweets, wafers, chewing gum, chips and tea.
companies.channels_supplied: Confectionery wholesale and some retail in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: A confectionery and snacks specialist wholesaler, so its customers are exactly the shops Diablo needs. Small scale, so better as a channel partner than national lead.

companies.name: Pine Tree
companies.distributes: Baby food, baby care, confectionery and tea.
companies.channels_supplied: Distribution to Tbilisi retail and pharmacies (inferred from baby food and baby care categories).
companies.fit_rationale: Combines confectionery with baby food and baby care, categories sold through pharmacies and family focused shelves. That mix suits a better-for-you sweets range.

companies.name: Greidi
companies.distributes: Wafers, biscuits, chocolate sweets and chewing gum.
companies.channels_supplied: Confectionery wholesale to Tbilisi shops.
companies.fit_rationale: A biscuit and wafer focused wholesaler, matching Diablo's biscuit and wafer lines. Small operator registered in 2018.

companies.name: Geokonditer
companies.distributes: Chocolate and sugar confectionery wholesale.
companies.channels_supplied: Confectionery wholesale to Tbilisi shops.
companies.fit_rationale: A confectionery wholesaler since 2006 with no visible brand portfolio. Possible sub-distributor.

companies.name: Gurmani
companies.distributes: Confectionery, dairy, meat products, juices and mineral water; also produces some lines.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale and retail; listed as a chocolate sweets supplier in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: Head office registered in Kutaisi but listed as a Tbilisi chocolate supplier. Low priority because it also manufactures.

companies.name: TID Foods
companies.distributes: Confectionery import and coffee.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: Small confectionery and coffee importer. Directory listing only.

companies.distributes: Confectionery import, pasta, flour and seafood.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: Small importer with confectionery in range. Directory listing only.

companies.distributes: Confectionery import, pasta and edible fats.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: Small confectionery importer. Directory listing only.

companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed in confectionery import and distribution; nothing else verified.

companies.distributes: Confectionery import and distribution; name suggests ice cream (unconfirmed).
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale in Tbilisi; shares an address with BD Company, also listed for confectionery import.
companies.fit_rationale: Could suit chilled storage needs for chocolate if it runs a cold chain. Unverified.

companies.distributes: Baby food, coffee, hygiene, paper and cleaning products.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale to Tbilisi retail and pharmacies.
companies.fit_rationale: Baby food and hygiene distributor that may reach pharmacies. Not a confectionery house.

companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: Tea and food wholesaler; adjacent category only.

companies.channels_supplied: Retail and HoReCa in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: Frozen and chilled logistics could help chocolate in summer, but no confectionery seen.

companies.fit_rationale: Chilled and frozen importer with 11 to 50 staff; confectionery would be new for it.

companies.channels_supplied: Importer and distributor to food producers and retail.

companies.name: GDM (Georgian Distribution-Marketing Company)
companies.distributes: Confectionery (Storck Merci and Toffifee, ETI, Choco Pie), snacks (Lays, Doritos), baking (Dr. Oetker), coffee, margarine, condensed milk, beverages.
companies.channels_supplied: About 7,000 trade outlets across Georgia via 60 crews and 5 branches (Tbilisi, Kutaisi, Batumi, Gurjaani, Akhaltsikhe); offers merchandising and category management.
companies.fit_rationale: Already runs imported European and Turkish confectionery through modern and traditional trade with in-store merchandising. No sugar-free line seen, so Diablo would fill a gap rather than compete. Part of GD Holding, giving logistics and warehousing depth.
what_they_do_well: Covers about 7,000 outlets nationwide from five branches with its own merchandising and category management.
Distributes Storck brands Merci and Toffifee plus ETI and Choco Pie in Georgia.

companies.name: Argo Distribution
companies.distributes: International FMCG: packaged confectionery (Haribo), pasta (Barilla), soft drinks (Capri-Sun), hot beverages (MacCoffee), tomato products, ready meals.
companies.channels_supplied: Supermarket chains, traditional retail, HoReCa, petrol stations and wholesale; partner logos include Carrefour, Nikora, Magniti, Spar, Smart, Goodwill, 2 Nabiji, Fresco and Agrohub.
companies.fit_rationale: A focused international brands house with Haribo as its confectionery anchor and named access to every major Georgian chain. A short portfolio leaves room for a sugar-free confectionery line. Its website shows placeholder figures, so scale and any link to Argo JSC brewery are unverified.
what_they_do_well: Lists Carrefour, Nikora, Spar, Smart, Goodwill and 2 Nabiji among its retail partners.
Represents Haribo, Barilla and Capri-Sun in Georgia.

companies.name: Tbilisi Holding Company (THC)
companies.distributes: Premium imported food (up to 500 items): confectionery (Ferrara), sauces (Torchin), cheese and dairy (Anchor), canned fish, tea (Hayleys), snacks; plus toys and tableware.
companies.channels_supplied: 5,000+ retail and wholesale points from small shops to hypermarkets and cafes; own Schirnhofer supermarket chain of 9 stores.
companies.fit_rationale: Thirty-year importer with five depots (Tbilisi, Kutaisi, Batumi, Telavi, Akhaltsikhe) and a 90-vehicle fleet, built around premium imported brands. Carries Ferrara confectionery but no visible sugar-free range. Listed in directories under its trading entity Everest 2010.
what_they_do_well: Founded 1994; supplies over 5,000 retail and wholesale outlets from five distribution centres.
Its brands Anchor, Hayleys and Schirnhofer won Golden Brand awards in 2022 and 2023.

companies.name: VG Distribution (Veyseloglu Group)
companies.distributes: Confectionery, fats, pasta and general packaged food from 30+ manufacturers in Azerbaijan, Turkey, Russia, Poland and India.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale to regional traders and direct to more than 3,500 outlets across Georgia, including major outlets.
companies.fit_rationale: Georgian arm of Azerbaijan's largest FMCG distributor, with offices in Tbilisi, Gori, Kutaisi and Batumi and warehouses in Tbilisi and Kutaisi. Already handles imported confectionery and would give Diablo regional reach beyond Tbilisi.
what_they_do_well: Operating in Georgia since 2010 and now reaching more than 3,500 outlets nationwide.
Runs four offices and two warehouses with about 160 staff.

companies.name: BD Company
companies.distributes: Chocolate and confectionery (Ferrero); reportedly also Roshen.
companies.channels_supplied: Confectionery wholesale to retail across Georgia; warehouse in Telavi.
companies.fit_rationale: Official Ferrero distributor in Georgia, so it already sells premium imported chocolate into chains and corner shops. A sugar-free line would complement rather than clash with Ferrero. One source calls it Roshen's official distributor, which needs confirming.
what_they_do_well: Listed as Ferrero's official distributor in Georgia.
Trading in chocolate wholesale since 2009 with a Telavi warehouse.

companies.name: Sweet Country
companies.distributes: Chocolate and sugar confectionery, pastry goods, pasta, cereals and detergents.
companies.channels_supplied: Confectionery wholesale with a Tbilisi retail point and warehouses in Sagarejo, Kutaisi, Akhaltsikhe, Batumi, Gori and Zugdidi.
companies.fit_rationale: A confectionery-first wholesaler with six regional warehouses, so sweets are its core business. Information comes from one directory, so the brand portfolio needs checking.
what_they_do_well: Runs confectionery warehouses in six regions outside Tbilisi.
Trading since 2005.

companies.name: Mziuri
companies.distributes: Chocolate and confectionery, coffee, tea, pasta, edible oils, baby care and personal care.
companies.channels_supplied: Retail across Georgia via a Kutaisi branch, Akhaltsikhe and Batumi offices and two Tbilisi warehouses.
companies.fit_rationale: Distributes both confectionery and baby and personal care, so it reaches grocery and family shoppers who are receptive to no-added-sugar claims. Regional offices add reach beyond Tbilisi.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 2004 with two Tbilisi warehouses and regional offices in Kutaisi, Akhaltsikhe and Batumi.

companies.name: Dapna
companies.distributes: Chocolate and confectionery, rusks, tea, oils, sugar, salt, mayonnaise, olives and hygiene paper.
companies.channels_supplied: Retail across Georgia via branches in Batumi, Khashuri, Kutaisi and Telavi.
companies.fit_rationale: Imports mainly Turkish and Azerbaijani brands (Shokki Mokki, Bizim Sufra, Maryam Tea) into traditional trade. A European sugar-free line would broaden a value-led portfolio; fit depends on price positioning.
what_they_do_well: Distributes brands including Shokki Mokki, Bizim Sufra and Maryam Tea.
Runs branches in Batumi, Khashuri, Kutaisi and Telavi.

companies.name: Euro Caucasus Supplies (House of Delicacies)

companies.channels_supplied: HoReCa and retail in Georgia; reported 400+ clients.
companies.fit_rationale: Delicatessen-style importer serving hotels, restaurants and retail, where premium imported sugar-free sweets and syrups fit. Brand list not published.
what_they_do_well: Reports more than 400 HoReCa and retail clients in Georgia.

companies.name: Reneco
companies.distributes: Food distribution including Granini juices, Baskin Robbins, regional foods and spices.
companies.channels_supplied: Supermarket chains: Agrohub, Goodwill, Carrefour Georgia, Nikora, Fresco, Universami and Spar Georgia.
companies.fit_rationale: Has a warehouse and delivery set-up already supplying Georgia's main supermarket chains. Confectionery is not its core, so Diablo would be a new category for it.
what_they_do_well: Supplies Carrefour Georgia, Nikora, Goodwill, Agrohub and Spar Georgia from its own warehouse.

companies.channels_supplied: Own distribution network and Nikora's 700+ store chain across Georgia.
companies.fit_rationale: Nikora's distribution arm imports food exclusively for the group and supplies one of Georgia's three largest chains. Listing via Partneri could open Nikora shelves, though Nikora is also a brand owner.
what_they_do_well: Distribution subsidiary of Nikora, which leads branded store sales in Tbilisi.

companies.channels_supplied: Retail across Georgia; specific chains not named.
companies.fit_rationale: Mixed food and household distributor that already lists confectionery. Brand-building track record with Golden Brand awards suggests marketing capability.
what_they_do_well: Its Papia and Avedov brands won Golden Brand awards in Georgia.

companies.fit_rationale: Importer and wholesaler that appears to run Marshe, a Tbilisi wholesale food store, giving a cash and carry style route to small shops. The Sera and Marshe link is inferred from a shared address.

companies.channels_supplied: Retail and HoReCa.
companies.fit_rationale: Already handles Monin syrups for HoReCa, a route for Diablo sugar-free syrups. Sister company of GDM, so approach via GDM first.
what_they_do_well: Represents Tito's vodka, Jameson and Chivas Regal in Georgia.

companies.name: Sweet Center
companies.distributes: Confectionery ingredients: chocolate and cocoa, toppings, cocktail syrups, fillings, creams and margarine (own Dila).
companies.channels_supplied: Bakeries, manufacturers and HoReCa across Georgia.
companies.fit_rationale: B2B supplier to bakeries and cafes that sells syrups and toppings, a possible route for Diablo syrups and spreads into foodservice. Not a route for retail confectionery.
what_they_do_well: Supplying confectionery ingredients since 2010; its Dila margarine has been on the market since 2001.

companies.name: Supta.ge (AID Group)
companies.distributes: B2B supplies: hygiene, disposables, stationery and foods for offices.
companies.channels_supplied: HoReCa, offices and salons via an online B2B platform with delivery.
companies.fit_rationale: Online B2B supplier to HoReCa and offices that sells office foods, a niche route for single-serve sugar-free snacks. Operator link to AID Group comes from a shared directory listing.

companies.name: PB Distribution
companies.distributes: Tea, coffee, household goods and hygiene products.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale from a Tbilisi warehouse.
companies.fit_rationale: Hot-drinks and household wholesaler; would only fit for Diablo syrups or biscuits alongside tea and coffee.

companies.name: Georgian Import Export Service
companies.distributes: Food products import and distribution.
companies.channels_supplied: Not stated; has branches.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed food importer and distributor in Tbilisi with branches. Portfolio unknown.

companies.name: Ukrainian Product
companies.distributes: Food products import and distribution, apparently Ukrainian goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Not stated.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed food importer in Tbilisi; Ukrainian imports often include confectionery, but this is not verified.

companies.name: Lorgo
companies.distributes: Food products import and distribution.
companies.channels_supplied: Not stated.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed food importer and distributor in Samgori, Tbilisi. Portfolio unknown.

companies.name: Horizon
companies.distributes: Food products import and distribution.
companies.channels_supplied: Not stated.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed food importer and distributor in Vazisubani, Tbilisi. Portfolio unknown.

companies.name: Ambari
companies.distributes: Food products import and distribution.
companies.channels_supplied: Not stated.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed food importer and distributor in Nadzaladevi, Tbilisi. Portfolio unknown.

companies.name: Organika Bio Shop
companies.distributes: Organic and bio foods, superfoods, diabetic and keto foods, sweeteners, vitamins, plant milks, eco household goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Own shops in Tbilisi (Abashidze 61 and Vazha Pshavela 51 listed; a directory mentions three stores) plus its own online shop with delivery.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Dedicated Diabetic and Keto category (54 products) and a sweeteners section; brands seen include Batom erythritol, Natumi, Roobar, Bett'r, Kookie Cat, Candy Tree and Bio Planet. No direct sugar-free chocolate rival identified on the home page.
companies.fit_rationale: The closest specialist fit in Tbilisi: an existing diabetic and keto category built mainly on European brands, so Diablo's chocolate, biscuits and spreads fill an obvious gap. Small (two or three stores plus web) but a fast, low-risk launch partner and shop window.
what_they_do_well: Runs a dedicated Diabetic and Keto range of 54 products alongside about 843 bio food lines on its webshop.

companies.name: Carrefour Georgia (Majid Al Futtaim Hypermarkets Georgia)
companies.distributes: Full grocery hypermarket and supermarket range including confectionery and snacks, organic and health food, imported and private label goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Own hypermarkets, supermarkets and Carrefour Express city stores; online orders via Wolt and Glovo; Carrefour app with MyCLUB loyalty.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Directory lists organic and health food and sports nutrition among imported categories; specific sugar-free brands not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: Georgia's international hypermarket operator with 75 stores by November 2022 (5 hypermarkets, 13 supermarkets and more than 50 convenience stores in 2022) and a stated openness to new suppliers, having worked with more than 800. A health and free-from bay in Tbilisi hypermarkets would give Diablo national visibility.
what_they_do_well: Opened its 75th Georgian store in Zugdidi in November 2022, ten years after its first Tbilisi Mall hypermarket.
Has worked with more than 800 suppliers since entering Georgia in 2012.

companies.name: Agrohub
companies.distributes: Organic, natural and healthy food, fresh produce, own dairy, meat and bakery, confectionery and imported FMCG.
companies.channels_supplied: Own hypermarkets and newer smaller branches in Tbilisi and Batumi; online farm products marketplace; own cafes.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Positions on organic, natural and healthy food; specific sugar-free confectionery brands not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: Health-positioned, premium Tbilisi retailer that imports around 1,500 FMCG lines directly, so it can buy Diablo without a distributor. Several Tbilisi branches (new openings in 2024 and 2025) and an affluent shopper base suit a premium no-added-sugar range.
what_they_do_well: Georgia's first vertically integrated retailer, carrying over 10,000 SKUs including about 1,500 FMCG items imported directly.
Opened a 3,000 sq m Avchala distribution centre with Bank of Georgia financing.

companies.name: Goodwill
companies.distributes: Premium hypermarket grocery range of about 50,000 SKUs, imported and local goods, ready meals and bakery.
companies.channels_supplied: Own hypermarkets in Tbilisi (including Galleria Tbilisi, Vake and Saburtalo), Rustavi, Gori and Batumi; own online shop; Wolt delivery.
companies.fit_rationale: Premium-positioned chain that imports about a quarter of its 50,000 SKUs directly and has said it wants more direct imports, a natural route for Diablo. Seven hypermarkets (2015 figure) and an online shop where chocolates are a strong seller. Own website not verified in this run.
what_they_do_well: Calls itself Georgia's first premium-focused hypermarket chain and imports about 25% of its 50,000 SKUs directly.
General director says chocolates are among the products that sell well in its online channel.

companies.name: Holland & Barrett Georgia
companies.based_out_of: Tbilisi, Georgia (franchise of Holland & Barrett, UK)
companies.distributes: Health food, vitamins, supplements, sports nutrition and better-for-you snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: Franchise store in Tbilisi listed on Wolt (Old Tbilisi district) and its own Georgian website.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Holland & Barrett format typically carries free-from and reduced-sugar snacks; the Georgian range was not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: A UK health retail banner in Tbilisi aimed at exactly Diablo's shopper, and a UK brand can be pitched through the familiar UK range logic. The operating franchisee and store count were not verified, so confidence is low.

companies.name: Nikora Trade
companies.distributes: Full grocery range, own meat, dairy, bakery and ice cream, imported European goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Nikora supermarkets and Nikora XL; the Libre discount banner appears to be operated by Nikora Trade; Wolt and Glovo delivery.
companies.fit_rationale: The largest single-banner chain with about 617 stores and roughly 19% of modern grocery, so a listing gives national reach from Tbilisi. Better as a second-wave target once Diablo has proof of sale in specialist and premium stores.
what_they_do_well: Runs about 617 stores and holds roughly 18.9% of the modern grocery market (2024).

companies.name: SPAR Georgia (JSC Foodmart)
companies.distributes: Supermarket and convenience grocery including confectionery, snacks, fresh food to go and SPAR private label.
companies.channels_supplied: SPAR, VAKE by SPAR and Ioli stores; webshop sparonline.ge; Wolt delivery. Foodmart is owned by Daily Group since 2024.
companies.fit_rationale: More than 380 SPAR stores nationally, with premium VAKE by SPAR stores in Tbilisi that suit an imported better-for-you range. Owned by Daily Group, so buying may be centralised with Daily and Magniti.
what_they_do_well: Grew from three Tbilisi supermarkets in 2014 to more than 380 stores and about 2,700 staff.

companies.name: Wolt Market Georgia
companies.distributes: Online supermarket range: groceries, snacks, confectionery and household essentials from own dark stores.
companies.channels_supplied: Wolt's own Wolt Market stores across Tbilisi (Baratashvili, Isani, Tsintsadze and others) delivered through the Wolt app.
companies.fit_rationale: Wolt Market buys stock itself through Tbilisi category specialists who negotiate directly with suppliers, so it is a genuine retailer rather than a marketplace. Fast online reach to young urban shoppers suits an impulse sugar-free chocolate and biscuit range.
what_they_do_well: Recruits Tbilisi category specialists to build assortment and negotiate directly with suppliers for its own online supermarket chain.

companies.name: Smart (Wissol Group)
companies.distributes: Supermarket and convenience grocery, mostly imported, plus own bakery; Wissol fuel station shops.
companies.channels_supplied: Smart supermarkets in Tbilisi and other cities, often co-located with Wissol fuel stations, Wendy's and Dunkin' outlets; Wolt delivery.
companies.fit_rationale: Wissol's Smart supermarkets source most groceries from imports, so a European brand is a natural fit, and the Wissol fuel network (over 100 stations) adds an impulse channel. Store count is dated (14 supermarkets in 2015) and the website was not verified.
what_they_do_well: EBRD says most groceries in Smart supermarkets are imported, with 85% of fresh produce grown locally.

companies.name: Gastronome (Gastronome Group)
companies.distributes: Premium delicatessen groceries, ready food and gourmet products.
companies.channels_supplied: Six Gastronome delicatessen stores in Tbilisi (including Saburtalo, Abashidze and Tskneti), Wolt delivery; group also runs restaurants.
companies.fit_rationale: Premium Tbilisi deli chain whose shoppers pay for imported quality, a good home for Diablo gift boxes and chocolate. Range and buying route not verified.
what_they_do_well: Has operated since 2019 and grew to six delicatessen branches plus four premium restaurants.

companies.name: Ori Nabiji (2 Nabiji)
companies.distributes: Convenience supermarket groceries, snacks, drinks, dairy, bakery and household items.
companies.channels_supplied: Own convenience stores nationwide with online ordering and delivery.
companies.fit_rationale: With over 400 stores and about 20.5% of modern grocery it is the second biggest chain group, giving reach across Tbilisi neighbourhoods. The small-box format suits single-serve sugar-free bars and sweets rather than the full range.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 2010 and credited with introducing the convenience store format to Georgia; now over 400 stores.

companies.name: Daily Group (Daily, Magniti, Gvirila, Kalata)
companies.distributes: Supermarket and convenience grocery; group also owns the Georgian Beer Company.
companies.channels_supplied: Daily, Magniti, Gvirila and Kalata banners plus SPAR and Ioli through Foodmart; about 1,700 stores; first store in Tashkent in 2025.
companies.fit_rationale: Georgia's largest grocery group with around 1,700 stores and about a third of modern grocery, so one listing could reach most Tbilisi districts. Many stores are regional and value-oriented, so approach after premium chains with sales data.
what_they_do_well: Became Georgia's leading supermarket group after buying Foodmart (SPAR, Ioli) and Magniti's 349 stores in 2024.

companies.name: Zgapari
companies.distributes: Full supermarket grocery range, bakery, seafood and organic vegetables.
companies.channels_supplied: 47 own supermarkets from Tbilisi to Gori and Akhaltsikhe; online orders with delivery or pickup; Qisa discount card.
companies.fit_rationale: Mid-sized Tbilisi-centred chain (47 stores) with its own online shop, large enough to matter and small enough to take a new imported range quickly. Health range not verified.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 2006 and now runs 47 supermarkets with its own loyalty card and online ordering.

companies.name: Epicalorie
companies.distributes: Organic food, health snacks, grains, nuts, supplements and personal care with vegan and gluten-free options.
companies.channels_supplied: Own organic shop at Akhvlediani Street, Tbilisi, and its own web shop.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Health-oriented snacks, vegan and gluten-free lines; specific brands not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: Specialist organic and health snack shop in central Tbilisi whose shoppers already look for better-for-you treats. Single store so volume is small; one directory source only.

companies.name: Fresco (Fresco Group)
companies.distributes: Supermarket groceries, own confectionery and ready meals, medicines, perfumery, household and stationery.
companies.channels_supplied: Ten own supermarkets across Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: Tbilisi-only chain of ten supermarkets that owns its sites, a compact first listing in the capital. It makes its own confectionery, so position Diablo as the sugar-free alternative.
what_they_do_well: Grew from one Varketili supermarket in 2010 to ten Tbilisi supermarkets on fully owned land and buildings.

companies.name: Tursa
companies.distributes: Supermarket groceries in a premium price tier.
companies.channels_supplied: Supermarket brand delivering through Wolt across about 20 Tbilisi districts.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed by Wolt as a top price-tier supermarket in Tbilisi, which suggests an affluent shopper. Store count, ownership and buying route not verified.

companies.name: Pharmhouse
companies.distributes: Medicines, health supplements and beauty products.
companies.channels_supplied: Pharmacy network in Tbilisi with a branch locator and loyalty scheme.
companies.fit_rationale: A Tbilisi pharmacy network with a loyalty programme where a diabetic-friendly sweets range could sit at the till. Network size not verified.

companies.name: Gulf Georgia (Sun Petroleum Georgia)
companies.distributes: Fuel, Gulf Store convenience goods, snacks and drinks.
companies.channels_supplied: 141 fuel stations including 43 in Tbilisi and 72 Gulf Stores.
companies.fit_rationale: 72 forecourt shops give impulse reach for single-serve sugar-free bars and sweets, with 43 stations in Tbilisi. Lower priority as forecourt ranges are narrow.
what_they_do_well: Operates 141 stations, 43 in Tbilisi, with 72 Gulf Stores serving customers.

companies.name: SOCAR Georgia Petroleum (WayMart)
companies.distributes: Fuel and WayMart convenience goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Nationwide SOCAR fuel station network with WayMart convenience stores.
companies.fit_rationale: One of the widest fuel networks in Georgia with its own WayMart convenience format, suitable for impulse sugar-free snacks. Store count not verified.
what_they_do_well: Manages its own WayMart convenience store brand alongside a nationwide fuel network since 2007.

companies.name: Supermarket Naturali
companies.distributes: Natural and fresh food from its own farm, ready meals and bakery.
companies.channels_supplied: Own supermarkets in Tbilisi including Nadzaladevi; Wolt delivery.
companies.fit_rationale: Health-positioned Tbilisi supermarket chain founded in 2014, but its range centres on its own farm produce. Conditional on it adding imported packaged better-for-you lines.
what_they_do_well: Renovated its Nadzaladevi branch with self-checkouts and underground parking, with expansion planned from 2024.

companies.name: Green Hamster Vegan Shop
companies.distributes: Vegan packaged foods and grocery.
companies.channels_supplied: Vegan shop listed on Wolt in Old Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: A vegan specialist could take vegan-friendly Diablo lines, but size and buying route are unknown.

companies.name: People's Pharmacy (Sakhalkho Aptiaki)
companies.distributes: Medicines and pharmacy goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Pharmacy network mostly in villages, run on a manager-partnership model backed by Synergy Capital.
companies.fit_rationale: Growing pharmacy network but focused on villages rather than Tbilisi, so only a conditional option for a diabetic sweets range.
what_they_do_well: Makes pharmacy managers shareholders of 10% to 40% in their outlets, a partnership model started in 2019.

companies.name: Impex Pharmacy
companies.distributes: Prescription and OTC medicines, supplements and personal care.
companies.channels_supplied: Pharmacies in Tbilisi; named as a partner pharmacy network by an importer.
companies.fit_rationale: A Tbilisi pharmacy network that could test a diabetic-friendly sweets bay; size not verified.

companies.name: ATU Duty Free Tbilisi
companies.distributes: Duty free fragrance, cosmetics, luxury goods, Georgian wine, food and souvenirs.
companies.channels_supplied: Departure stores at Tbilisi International Airport, including a 430 sq m main store and a 400 sq m Georgian Wine store.
companies.fit_rationale: Travel retail could take sugar-free chocolate gifting, but the Tbilisi stores focus on luxury and Georgian wine. Conditional on a confectionery bay.
what_they_do_well: Invested nearly 800,000 euros to expand its Tbilisi Airport stores in 2023.

companies.name: Fix Price Georgia
companies.distributes: Fixed-price discount goods including some confectionery and snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: Fix Price stores in Tbilisi (Varketili listed) on Wolt.
companies.fit_rationale: Discount format is a weak fit for a premium sugar-free brand; listed only for completeness. Operator and store count not verified.

companies.name: Rompetrol Georgia
companies.distributes: Fuel and forecourt shop goods.
companies.channels_supplied: 85 fuel stations nationally (end 2020) with on-site shops.
companies.fit_rationale: Forecourt shops offer limited impulse space; lower priority than Gulf and SOCAR.
what_they_do_well: Ran 85 stations and was named Georgia's leading fuel supplier by the competition agency in 2021.

companies.name: Lukoil Georgia
companies.distributes: Fuel and forecourt shop goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Lukoil fuel stations with shops in Tbilisi and elsewhere.
companies.fit_rationale: Forecourt shops with medium coverage; low priority for a premium range.

companies.name: Agro Men
companies.distributes: High-end fruit and vegetables, organic products, meat and dairy, local and imported.
companies.channels_supplied: Own stores with online sales and delivery through Glovo, Wolt and Bolt.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Organic products; sugar-free confectionery not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: Premium organic-leaning grocer with online reach, but fresh-led so packaged confectionery would be a new category. City not stated in source.
what_they_do_well: Expanded from fruit and vegetables into meat and dairy since 2018 and works mainly with organic suppliers.

companies.name: GreenGreen Biomarket
companies.distributes: Natural farm products, produce, meat, dairy, spices and oils.
companies.channels_supplied: Single biomarket in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: Natural products store but sourcing is local and regional, so imported confectionery is uncertain.

companies.name: Rocket Men
companies.distributes: Online supermarket groceries.
companies.channels_supplied: App-based online supermarket with small warehouses and courier delivery in Tbilisi.
companies.fit_rationale: App-only grocer that could list a sugar-free range quickly, but current trading status was not verified.
